sheets.title: The front door — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: Skip and the theme key both sat in the card's top-right corner and drew over each other; the theme key now takes the top-left, the corner Skip does not use. The two roads carry their whole visible text as their accessible name, so what a person reads is what a voice-control user says (WCAG 2.5.3).

sheets.title: The statusline is keys again — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: The foot carried a second text field — disabled, reading "Questions only", for anyone without an on-device model — with the plane glyphs pushed to the far edge, while the command bar above already said "Command or ask…". The strip is back to its contract (docs/design/controls.md): seven equal keys, one left-aligned row. The command bar is the chrome's one field, and a sentence it cannot run goes to Support as a question. The buffer's empty state is its two mono lines, not a copy of the list pane's tip.

sheets.title: No strip on a phone — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: A phone drew the ask field as a whole row under the content again. A phone draws no statusline (DESIGN.md § Touch): what it held is behind the top bar's overflow key, and the row goes back to the content.

sheets.title: The overflow sheet — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: One heading in the app was set in tracked capitals. Sentence case everywhere is the rule (DESIGN.md § Typography); the heading now reads like the rest.

sheets.title: A new login — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: The consent line under "Suggest names on device" named `https://%2A` on every new login: the Websites row defaults to a wildcard, and the URL parser percent-encoded it into a hostname. Only a plain hostname is context now; a pattern is not.

sheets.title: Settings names what the rail names — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: The rail listed six settings categories and the tab row five: Vaults had a route, a panel and a rail row but no tab. The rail and the tabs name the same views.

sheets.title: Connections — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: A Vercel token form — a paragraph and two fields — stood above Connected for everyone, guests included. It is one disclosure line now, opened by whoever has a token to seal.
